entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State-opposite party.

2. The instant bail application, under Section 439 Cr.P.C., has been filed with a prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 174 of 2017, under Sections 406, 409, 420, 467, 468 and 471 of I.P.C., Police Station- Farah, District- Mathura, during the pendency of trial.
3. Counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is a lady and was not named in the first information report.
It is further contended that the applicant was the Director of the Kalpataru Mega Mart Company.
She had never been the Director of the Kalpataru Build Tech Corporation Smt.

sentences.text: 1 Company Ltd.
She was only the share-holder of the said company.
As such, she had no role in the day to day affairs of the said company.
She had no role in the policy decision of the said company.
No amount has been credited in the account of the applicant.
The applicant is not a beneficiary of the illicit transaction.
She has been falsely implicated in the instant case because of being the sister-in-law of the named accused.
The role of the applicant is clearly distinguishable from that of the Directors of the Kalpataru Build Tech Corporation Company Ltd.

entities.text: Kalpataru Build Tech Corporation Company Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The criminal history of the applicant has been explained in para no. 10 of the bail application.
The applicant is in jail since 11.01.2023.
In case, she is enlarged on bail, she will not misuse the said liberty.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the prayer for bail but could not satisfactorily dispute the aforesaid submissions from the record.

5. Having heard counsel for the parties and having perused the record this Court prima facie finds that the applicant is a lady and had never been the Director of the Kalpataru Build Tech Corporation Company Ltd.

entities.text: Kalpataru Build Tech Corporation Company Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: No amount has been credited in the accout of the applicant.

Further, the applicant has remained confined for more than eight months and after submission of the charge-sheet there is no hope of early conclusion of trial, more so when no reasonable apprehension has been brought to the fore by the State that the applicant, if enlarged on bail, would either tamper with the evidence or delay the trial or intimidate the witness, without commenting on merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant Smt Reeta Singh, involved in the aforesaid case crime be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two heavy sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to the conditions that she:
(i) shall appear on the date fixed by the trial court;
(ii) shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence; and,
(iii) shall not pressurize the prosecution witnesses.
7.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
